Dialogue.Page: Brevipes: ...It is only me, Polytricha and Calveryi left. After they got ill, the other's disappeared one day, without a trace.
Brevipes: I can barely remember their names, it's like they've been erased from time! It's all that damned asteroid's fault... It's begun cracking, there's a faint green glow inside.
Brevipes: I don't know what's going to happen except that sooner or later we'll all get sick and suffer the same fate...
Brevipes: But perhaps I can create a device to reverse the effects of the asteroid. I must try!
